# githubbot-core

> Neutral, installable GitHub maintenance core (Python standard library only): issue triage,
> duplicate detection, PR summaries, read-only health/traffic/star reports, a preview/apply
> contract for every write, a plugin SPI and signed exact-SHA review receipts.

Languages: en, de

## Entry points

- CLI: `githubbot-core --help` (also `python -m githubbot_core`); add `--json` for the
  `githubbot-core.result/v1` envelope. Writes need `--apply`; default is preview.
- Python API: `githubbot_core.triage`, `githubbot_core.actions`, `githubbot_core.health`,
  `githubbot_core.traffic`, `githubbot_core.stars`, `githubbot_core.pr_review`,
  `githubbot_core.plugins`, `githubbot_core.review_gate`, `githubbot_core.credentials`.
- Plugin SPI v1: entry-point group `githubbot_core.plugins`, factory returning an object with
  `name`, `spi_version`, `describe()`, optional `plan(ctx)` and `pr_policy_checks(pr, files, diff)`.
